blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: In recent years, with advances in multimodal interaction technologies and the growing demand for intelligent emotional support, Multimodal Emotional Support Conversation (MESC) has emerged as an important task. However, existing systems still suffer from shallow responses and inappropriate support strategies due to weak semantic feedback, cross-dimension reward compensation, and coarse reasoning supervision. To address these challenges, we propose FACES, a fine-grained gated semantic alignment framework for MESC. Specifically, FACES integrates multi-source rewards to construct multidimensional semantic and functional alignment signals, employs a non-compensatory gated fusion mechanism to reduce cross-dimension reward offset, and leverages structured Chain-of-Thought (CoT) anchors to perform token-level credit assignment. Under a controlled response-length protocol, FACES improves the average MLLM-based evaluation score from 3.61 to 4.04 and achieves an 80.22% pairwise win rate over SOTA. Human evaluation under the same protocol yields a 75.3% preference rate. Results on three external datasets further support transferability. The code and dataset are available at https://github.com/OCT-ARR/arr.
blocks.zh: 近年来,随着多模式互动技术的进步以及对智能情感支持的需求不断增长,多模式情感支持对话已成为一项重要任务。 然而,由于语义反馈薄弱,交叉分配奖励补偿,以及粗糙的推理监督,现有的系统仍然受到浅答和不适当的支持策略的影响. 为了应付这些挑战,我们提议设立FACES,作为MESC精细的门式语义协调框架。 具体地说,FACES整合了多源奖励,以构建多语义和功能对齐信号,采用非补偿性门式聚变机制以减少交叉分配奖励抵消,并利用结构化的Cain-of-Thought(CoT)主播来完成象征级信用任务. 根据可控响应长度协议,FACES将基于MLLM的平均值评价分数从3.61提高到4.04,并实现80.22%的双向胜率高于SOTA. 根据同一协议进行的人类评价的优惠率为75.3%。 三个外部数据集的结果进一步支持了可转移性。 数据集见https://github.com/OCT-ARR/arr。

blocks.en: Multimodal Emotional Support Conversation (MESC) Chu et al. (2025) extends ESC Liu et al. (2021) by generating empathetic, appropriate, and supportive responses from dialogue context and multimodal cues such as facial expressions, postures, and interaction context Chaubey et al. (2026) ; Lu et al. (2025) . Beyond producing a superficially natural response, MESC requires models to infer users’ emotions, underlying causes, and support needs while grounding these in visual evidence. Correct emotion recognition alone does not ensure appropriate support Liu et al. (2021) ; Wang et al. (2024a) . In Figure 1 , the baseline identifies anger and relationship conflict but merely paraphrases the user, illustrating the gap between understanding and supportive action.

blocks.en: To better understand users and select support strategies, prior work has advanced MESC through dataset construction Chu et al. (2025) , multimodal modeling Le et al. (2026) , and reasoning-based training for support generation Wang et al. (2025a) . Complementary work personalizes multimodal support through memory Tu et al. (2025) and links emotion recognition and cause inference to support generation Tu et al. (2026) . Reasoning-based methods use structured CoT Wei et al. (2022) to make explicit how inferences about user emotions and underlying causes guide support strategy selection. In particular, FIRES Wang et al. (2025a) introduces flexible thinking and shows that reinforcement learning (RL) objectives improve structured reasoning and final response quality in MESC.
blocks.zh: 为了更好地理解用户和选择支持策略,先前的工作通过数据集构建Chu等人推进了MESC. (2025年),多模式模式Le等人(2026年),以及支持一代王等人(2025a)的推理训练. 补充工作通过记忆Tu等人(2025年)使多式联运支持个性化,并将情感识别和原因推论与支持生成Tu等人(2026年)联系起来. 基于理性的方法使用结构化的CoT Wei等人(2022年)来明确用户情绪和根本原因的推论如何指导支持策略的选择. 特别是FIRES WAN et al. (2025a)引入了灵活的思维,并表明强化学习(RL)目标提高了MESC的结构推理和最终反应质量.

blocks.en: Despite this progress, existing RL objectives for MESC still face three limitations in translating intermediate understanding into effective support. First, surface-overlap metrics such as BLEU and ROUGE-L Papineni et al. (2002) ; Lin (2004) poorly capture cross-modal grounding, semantic consistency, and supportive intent, providing weak feedback on whether a response meets the user’s support needs. Second, additive reward fusion can let strong understanding scores mask a poor support strategy or ineffective response Van Moffaert et al. (2013) . Accurate emotion or situation understanding alone cannot compensate for these support failures. Third, existing MESC methods relying on completion-level rewards Wang et al. (2025a) lack stage-specific credit for visual grounding, emotion and situation understanding, strategy planning, or response generation. This coarse feedback makes it difficult to identify and correct the reasoning errors underlying an inappropriate support response.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展,在将中间理解转化为有效支持方面,MESC的现有保护责任目标仍然面临三个限制。 第一,表面重叠度量衡,如BLEU和ROUGE-L Papineni等人(2002年);Lin(2004年)没有很好地掌握跨模式地基、语义一致性以及支持意图,对反应是否满足用户的支持需求提供反馈不力。 其次,添加剂奖励聚变可以让强理解分数掩盖支持策略不佳或反应无效的Van Moffaert等人(2013年). 准确的情感或情况理解本身并不能弥补这些支持失败. 第三,依靠完成级奖励的现有MESC方法 王等编. (2025a)在视觉定位,情感和情境理解,战略规划,或反应生成方面缺乏针对阶段的信用. 这种粗糙的反馈使得难以识别和纠正支持反应不当背后的推理错误.

blocks.en: To address these issues, we propose FACES, an MESC framework that uses gated multidimensional rewards to guide fine-grained token updates. Specifically, FACES uses CLIP Radford et al. (2021) for visual perception, MiniLM Wang et al. (2020) for emotion understanding, and a multimodal large language model (MLLM) judge Zheng et al. (2023) ; Chen et al. (2024) for situation understanding, support strategy, and response outcome. After a format-and-outcome warm-up, non-compensatory gated reward fusion limits compensation for weak strategy or response quality. Reasoning-stage markers route dimension-specific token-level advantages to the corresponding CoT and response spans, jointly optimizing intermediate reasoning and final response generation.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这些问题,我们提议采用FACES这一MESC框架,利用门面的多层面奖励来指导精细的象征性更新。 具体来说,FACES使用CLIP Radford等人(2021年)进行视觉感知,MiniLM. Wang et al. (2020)用于情感理解,以及多模式大语言模型(MLLM)法官Zheng et al. (2023); Chen et al. (2024)用于情况理解,支持策略,以及反应结果. 经过形式和结果的热身后,非补偿性的门式奖赏聚变限制了对弱战略或反应质量的补偿. 理性阶段标记路由维度特定符号级对相应CoT和响应跨度的优势,共同优化中间推理和最终响应生成.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are as follows: • We propose a multi-source semantic reward scheme that provides more reliable semantic-level supervision than surface-overlap metrics. • We introduce format-and-outcome warm-up with non-compensatory gated reward fusion to reduce cross-dimension compensation. • We propose fine-grained semantic alignment rewards for structured CoT and outcome generation, aligning dimension-specific feedback with token spans to jointly optimize intermediate reasoning and the final response.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献如下: 我们提出了一个多来源语义奖励计划,提供比表面重叠度量标准更可靠的语义层面监督。 我们采用格式和结果的热身,采用不补偿的门式奖励聚餐,以减少交叉分配补偿。 我们提议对结构化的CoT和结果生成进行精细的语义调整奖励,使特定维度的反馈与符号跨度保持一致,以便共同优化中间推理和最终反应。

blocks.en: 2.1 MESC Research
blocks.zh: 2.1 MESC公司 研究

blocks.en: Compared with traditional ESC Liu et al. (2021) , MESC uses multimodal cues alongside dialogue, providing additional evidence about the help-seeker’s emotion and situation when words are ambiguous Chu et al. (2025) ; Park et al. (2024) . Two representative approaches have emerged. The first fuses multimodal signals to infer emotion and guide support generation, through sequential emotion–strategy–response modeling Chu et al. (2025) or psychologically informed optimization Le et al. (2026) . The second makes intermediate decisions explicit, using flexible reasoning over visual context, emotion, situation, and strategy Wang et al. (2025a) , or appraisal-guided reasoning and retrieval Chu et al. (2026) . But remaining challenges include weak semantic feedback, compensation across reward dimensions, and insufficient supervision for intermediate reasoning; these are the problems FACES aims to address.
blocks.zh: 与传统的ESC Liu等人(2021年)相比,MESC在对话的同时使用多式联运提示,提供了更多证据,说明求助者在言语模棱两可时的情绪和处境(2025年);Park等人(2024年)。 出现了两种有代表性的办法。 第一种方式通过依次情感-战略-反应模型Chu等人(2025年)或心理上知情的优化Le等人(2026年),导导出情感并引导支持生成。 第二则明确了中间决定,对视觉背景,情感,情况,策略王等人(2025年a)采用灵活推理,或评价指导推理和检索朱等人(2026年). 但是,仍然存在的挑战包括语义反馈薄弱、报酬层面的补偿以及对中间推理的监督不足;这些都是FACES旨在解决的问题。

blocks.en: 2.2 Reward Evaluation and Fusion
blocks.zh: 2.2 奖励评价和融合

blocks.en: Reward evaluation and fusion aim to build reliable supervision and coordinate multiple objectives. Preference-based learning can optimize a policy through a learned reward model Christiano et al. (2017) ; Ouyang et al. (2022) ; Stiennon et al. (2020) ; Bai et al. (2022) . Later work develops psychology-grounded, multi-perspective reward models Wang et al. (2026a) . MultiMood Le et al. (2026) combines psychological criteria with PPO Schulman et al. (2017) and GRPO Shao et al. (2024) ; G-Eval Liu et al. (2023) , Prometheus Kim et al. (2024) , PandaLM Wang et al. (2024b) , STICKERCONV Zhang et al. (2024) , and related studies Zhao et al. (2024) demonstrate the utility of model-based evaluation. However, linear fusion can allow strong dimensions to mask weak ones Van Moffaert et al. (2013) , motivating non-compensatory reward fusion in multimodal emotional support conversations.

blocks.en: 2.3 Fine-grained Reward Optimization
blocks.zh: 2.3 精细奖励优化

blocks.en: Fine-grained reward optimization moves beyond outcome-only feedback by supervising intermediate reasoning steps or local response segments. Prior work shows that process-level feedback improves reasoning reliability Lightman et al. (2024) , and dense local signals are useful for multimodal alignment Yu et al. (2024) . In ESC, FIRES optimizes flexible multimodal reasoning via completion-level rewards; RLVER derives emotion rewards from simulated users ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2026b ) . Other methods provide finer-grained supervision at different levels: MindChat-R0 applies GRPO to structured empathetic reasoning; AFlow supervises dialogue prefixes; PEER trains a unified process–outcome reward model ( She et al., 2025 ; Zou et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025c ) . In MESC, FACES uses non-compensatory fusion for heterogeneous dimension-level signals, routing their group-relative advantages to aligned token spans.
blocks.zh: 通过监督中间推理步骤或局部响应部分,精细的奖励优化运动超越了只结果反馈. 先前的研究表明,流程层面的反馈提高了推理可靠性Lightman等人(2024年),密集的局部信号对多式联运对Yu等人(2024年)也有帮助. 在ESC中,FIRES通过完成级奖励优化了灵活的多式联运推理;RLVER从模拟用户那里获得情感奖励(Wang等人,2025a); Wang et al., 2026b ).  Wang. 其他方法提供各级更精细的监督: MindChat-R0将GRPO应用于结构化的同情推理;AFlow监督对话框前缀;PEER训练一个统一的流程-结果奖励模式(She等人,2025年;Zou等人,2026年;Wang等人,2025年c). 在MESC中,FACES使用非补偿性聚变来表示不同的维度级信号,将其群相对的优点引导到对齐的符号间距.

blocks.en: 3.1 Multi-source Semantic Rewards
blocks.zh: 3.1 多来源语义奖

blocks.en: For reward construction, BLEU and ROUGE-L primarily measure lexical overlap with reference responses Papineni et al. (2002) ; Lin (2004) and may assign low scores to semantically valid empathetic replies with different wording. To provide more reliable supervision, we construct multi-source rewards that extend beyond surface matching.
blocks.zh: 关于奖励构建,BLEU和ROUGE-L主要衡量词汇与参考答复的重叠,Papineni等人(2002年);Lin(2004年),并可能给具有不同措辞的含蓄性答复分配低分。 为了提供更可靠的监督,我们构建了超越表面匹配的多源奖励.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Dataset. We conduct training and in-domain evaluation on MESC-FT, a FIRES-built dataset Wang et al. (2025a) on top of MESC Chu et al. (2025) for multimodal emotional support conversations, which provides instance-level flexible-thinking supervision. We use an approximately 8:1:1 split for training, validation, and testing. For cross-dataset evaluation, we construct MELD-ESC300, a 300-sample external test set derived from MELD Poria et al. (2019) , and evaluate zero-shot transfer on the unseen multimodal benchmarks StickerConv Zhang et al. (2024) and AvaMERG Zhang et al. (2025) . These datasets are used only for evaluation, without fine-tuning. Details of MELD-ESC300 construction and the StickerConv/AvaMERG evaluation protocols are provided in Appendix G .
blocks.zh: 数据集. 我们进行MESC-FT的培训和国内评价,这是MESC Chu等人之上的Wang等人(2025a)所建FIRES数据集。 (2025)用于多模式情感支持对话,提供实例层面的灵活思维监督. 我们使用大约8:1:1的分数进行训练、验证和测试。 为了进行跨数据集评价,我们构建了MELD-ESC300,这是从MELD Poria等人(2019年)中得出的300个抽样外部测试集,并用看不见的多式联运基准SpikerConv Zhang等人(2024年)和AvaMERG Zhang等人(2025年)来评价零镜头传输。 这些数据集仅用于评价,没有微调. 附录G详细介绍了MELD-ESC300的建造和粘合剂Conv/AvaMERG的评价协议。

blocks.en: Evaluation Metrics. We evaluate responses using automatic metrics, MLLM judgments, and human preferences. Automatic metrics include BLEU-2 (B-2) Papineni et al. (2002) , ROUGE-L (R-L) Lin (2004) , METEOR (M.) Banerjee and Lavie (2005) , BERTScore-F1 ( F BERT F_{\text{BERT}} ) Zhang et al. (2020) , Distinct-3 (Dist-3) Li et al. (2016) , and DIFF-EPITOME (DIFF-E.) Lee et al. (2022) ; higher is better except for DIFF-E. Following StickerConv’s MLLM evaluation protocol Zhang et al. (2024) , we use Qwen2.5-VL-32B-Instruct-AWQ as the primary post-hoc judge Bai et al. (2025b) , distinct from the training-time reward judge. As a cross-family robustness check, GLM-4.6V-Flash judges the same fixed candidate pairs given identical dialogue context and visual evidence. blocks.en: 4.2.1 Automatic Evaluation

blocks.en: Table 1 shows that FACES leads on METEOR, Distinct-3, and DIFF-EPITOME, while FIRES leads on BLEU-2 and ROUGE-L and Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite on BERTScore-F1. In contrast, its gains over FIRES on METEOR, BERTScore-F1, Distinct-3, and DIFF-EPITOME suggest stronger semantic correspondence, greater response diversity, and better support-strategy alignment. This pattern is consistent with semantic rewards favoring meaning over wording, while strategy and outcome gates discourage plausible but unhelpful replies.

We average three judge prompts per metric to reduce prompt bias; detailed evaluation rules and prompts are in Appendix B.2 .

blocks.en: Table 2 (a) shows that Ours (Full) improves all three pointwise dimensions over FIRES (Baseline) under cap-15, raising the average from 3.61 to 4.04. blocks.en: We further conduct blind pairwise preference evaluation under the same length-controlled setting. We use three prompt variants with bidirectional candidate swapping, and majority voting reduces prompt and position bias.

blocks.en: To validate the cap-15 model-based evaluation, three annotators compared anonymized FACES and FIRES responses on all 450 MESC-FT and 300 MELD-ESC300 instances, assessing empathy, multimodal appropriateness, strategy suitability, and helpfulness using the same context and visual evidence. blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Study

blocks.en: To analyze the three main designs, we ablate multi-source rewards, non-compensatory gating, and fine-grained credit assignment from FACES using the same test set and evaluation protocol.

blocks.en: Table 5 shows that Ours (Full) leads on METEOR, BERTScore-F1, Distinct-3, and DIFF-EPITOME, reflecting stronger semantic quality, diversity, and support-strategy alignment. Distinct metric declines across ablations reveal the components’ complementary roles. Omitting multi-source rewards boosts BLEU-2 and ROUGE-L but lowers semantic and support-oriented metrics, consistent with overlap-based rewards favoring lexical matching. The overall profile weakens without non-compensatory gating; additive fusion allows cross-dimension compensation. Fine-grained credit assignment matters: its removal causes broad degradation, supporting span-aligned token-level supervision. Appendices E and F detail dimension-level ablations and hyperparameter sensitivity analyses.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We present FACES , a fine-grained gated semantic alignment framework for MESC. It addresses weak semantic supervision, compensatory reward fusion, and coarse credit assignment through multidimensional rewards, non-compensatory gating, and span-aligned token-level advantages. On MESC-FT, FACES improves several automatic metrics and is preferred to FIRES in matched cap-15 MLLM and human evaluations. This preference advantage persists under an independent GLM judge, while ablations support the contributions of the three main designs. Evaluations on three external datasets provide further evidence of transfer without additional training. These findings highlight fine-grained semantic alignment with non-compensatory gating as a promising direction for MESC generation.
blocks.zh: 我们提出FACES, 一个精细的门形语义校正框架 MESC。 它通过多方面的奖励、无补偿的配给和跨符号级的优势,解决语义监督薄弱、补偿性奖励和粗糙的信贷分配问题。 在MESC-FT方面,FACES改进了几种自动度量衡,比FIRES更受青睐,具有相应的上限-15 MLLM和人类评价. 这种偏好优势在一位独立的GLM法官的领导下继续存在,而拼凑则支持三个主要设计的贡献. 对三个外部数据集的评价提供了未经额外培训而转移的进一步证据。 这些结论突出了精细的语义上与非补偿性的配乐一致,是MESC生成的有希望的方向.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Although FACES shows consistent gains on multimodal emotional support generation, this study still leaves room for further extensions in personalization and evaluation. It focuses on instance-level semantic alignment and therefore does not explicitly model user-specific preferences. Moreover, our experimental setup prioritizes reproducibility and controlled comparison by relying on automatic metrics, MLLM-based assessment, pairwise human preference evaluation, and keyframe-based visual inputs. While these design choices are sufficient to establish the effectiveness of FACES in the present setting, future work could further strengthen the framework through finer-grained human evaluation, more diverse annotators, and richer multimodal signals such as vocal prosody and physiological signals in realistic support settings.
blocks.zh: 虽然法国足协在多模式情感支持生成方面不断取得进展,但这项研究仍然为个性化和评价留下了进一步扩展的余地。 它侧重于实例级语义对齐,因此没有明确模式化用户特有的偏好. 此外,我们的实验设置通过依靠自动度量衡、基于MLLM的评估、双向人类偏好评价以及基于关键框架的视觉投入,确定可复制性和可控比较性的优先次序。 虽然这些设计选择足以在目前情况下确定FACES的有效性,但今后的工作可以通过更精细的人类评价、更多样化的注释员以及更丰富的多模式信号,例如在现实支持环境下的声优和生理信号,进一步加强框架。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: This study uses the MESC-FT dataset and constructs the MELD-ESC300 external generalization test set from publicly available MELD/EMOTyDA resources. All data are used solely for research purposes, and we strictly comply with the licensing, citation, and redistribution requirements of the original datasets. For released code, datasets, or derived resources, we avoid redistributing raw audio, video, or image materials without proper authorization; instead, we provide guidance for obtaining the original datasets, along with data processing scripts and reproduction instructions.
blocks.zh: 本研究使用MESC-FT数据集,并从公开的MELD/EMOTyDA资源构建MELD-ESC300外部通用化测试集. 所有数据都只用于研究目的,我们严格遵守原始数据集的许可、引用和再分配要求。 对于发布代码,数据集,或衍生资源,我们避免未经适当授权再分配原始音频,视频或图像材料;相反,我们为获取原始数据集提供指导,同时提供数据处理脚本和复制指令.

blocks.en: This work focuses on multimodal emotional support conversation generation, but the proposed model remains a research prototype. It should not be used as a tool for clinical diagnosis, psychotherapy, or crisis intervention without professional supervision. The model may inherit biases from the training data and foundation models, which could lead to inappropriate judgments in emotion recognition, support strategy selection, or response generation. For acute psychological crises, personal safety risks, or other scenarios requiring professional intervention, any real-world deployment should incorporate human oversight, safety screening, and professional referral protocols to determine whether and how the system should respond.
blocks.zh: 这部作品侧重于多模式情感支持对话的生成,但拟议模型仍然是研究的原型. 它不应被用作在没有专业监督的情况下进行临床诊断、心理治疗或危机干预的工具。 该模型可能继承培训数据和基础模型的偏见,这可能导致在情感识别、支持战略选择或反应生成方面作出不适当的判断。 对于严重的心理危机、人身安全风险或其他需要专业干预的情况,任何实际部署都应包括人的监督、安全检查和专业转诊协议,以确定系统是否和如何应对。

blocks.en: This section reports the prompt templates used in FACES . The prompt design follows three principles. First, training-time reward construction and post-hoc evaluation use separate prompt families because they serve different purposes: the former provides optimization signals for the policy, whereas the latter measures the quality of fixed model outputs under independently specified evaluation criteria. Second, for every scoring task, we use three semantically equivalent prompt variants that preserve the same input fields, scoring criteria, score range, and output schema while varying their surface realization. This design reduces sensitivity to any single prompt formulation without changing the underlying evaluation objective. Third, all prompts require machine-readable JSON outputs, enabling deterministic parsing and consistent aggregation across instances.
blocks.zh: 本节报告FACES中使用的快速模板。 即时设计遵循三项原则. 首先,培训时间奖励建造和浩劫后评价使用单独的即时家庭,因为它们服务于不同的目的:前者为政策提供优化信号,而后者根据独立指定的评价标准衡量固定模式产出的质量。 其次,对于每个评分任务,我们使用三个星座等效的即时变体,保留相同的输入字段,评分标准,评分范围,输出计划,同时改变它们的表面实现. 这种设计降低了对任何单一的即时制剂的敏感性,同时又不改变基本的评价目标。 第三,所有提示都要求有机器可读的JSON输出,从而能够确定各种实例的解析和一致的汇总。

blocks.en: B.2 MLLM Evaluation Prompts

blocks.en: For automatic MLLM evaluation, we use complementary pointwise scoring and blind pairwise preference comparison. Pointwise evaluation measures each response independently along Empathy, Multimodal Appropriateness, and Context–Response Consistency, whereas pairwise evaluation asks the judge to select the better overall emotional-support response or return a tie. The former provides interpretable dimension-level measurements, while the latter captures holistic quality when different strengths and weaknesses must be considered jointly. In pairwise comparisons, model identities are hidden, and both candidates are evaluated using the same dialogue context and visual evidence.
blocks.zh: 对于自动的MLLM评价,我们使用互补的点评和盲对偏好比较. 尖端评价按照“同情”、“多式联运适当性”和“背景-反应一致性”分别对每项反应进行独立衡量,而双端评价则要求法官选择更好的整体情感支持反应或返回平局。 前者提供可解释的维度水平测量,而后者在必须共同考虑不同强项和弱项时掌握整体质量. 在对偶比较中,模型身份被隐藏,两个候选人使用相同的对话上下文和视觉证据进行评估.

blocks.en: Unlike training-time reward scoring, post-hoc MLLM judges receive no reference situation, strategy, or response annotations. Consequently, a candidate can be assessed for contextual appropriateness without requiring its wording or support strategy to match a single dataset reference.
blocks.zh: 与培训时间奖励评分不同的是,劳动和法学硕士后法官得不到参考情况、战略或答复说明。 因此,可以评估候选人是否适合具体情况,而不需要其措辞或支助战略来匹配单一数据集参考。

blocks.en: For each pointwise metric, we apply three semantically equivalent prompt variants and average the resulting scores. Pairwise evaluation uses the same number of prompt variants together with bidirectional candidate swapping and majority voting, reducing sensitivity to prompt wording and presentation order. For the length-controlled evaluations reported in the main results and Appendix C , all think-related fields and think-specific criteria are removed from the judge input and prompt. The judge therefore evaluates only the visible, length-controlled final responses rather than explicit reasoning traces. All prompts require structured JSON outputs; invalid or unparsable pairwise outputs are conservatively treated as ties. Table 15 summarizes the shared evaluation rules, Table 16 defines the pointwise dimensions, and Tables 17 and 18 present the representative prompts.
blocks.zh: 对于每一点的衡量标准,我们采用三种模拟等效的即时变数,并平均得分。 对等评价使用同样数量的即时变体,以及双向候选人互换和多数投票,降低了对即时措辞和列报顺序的敏感性。 对于主要结果和附录C中报告的长度控制评价,法官的投入中应删除所有与思想有关的领域和具体思想标准,并迅速予以删除。 因此,法官只评价明显、长控制的最后答复,而不是明确的推理痕迹。 所有提示需要结构化的 JSON 输出;无效或无法对等输出被保守地视为关联. 表15总结了共同评价规则,表16界定了指针尺寸,表17和18列出了代表提示。

blocks.zh: C.1 受控视图

blocks.en: We consider a response-only view without a word limit and three length-controlled views. In the response-only no-cap view, the judge sees the dialogue context, attached images, and the final response only; the prompt excludes the think section and no think-specific evaluation criterion is used. This view shows the same preference trend, but it may still be affected by response-length differences. Therefore, we focus the reported controlled results on the length-controlled cap-30/cap-25/cap-15 views. In these views, each candidate response is prefix-truncated to at most N N words, where N ∈ { 30 , 25 , 15 } N\in\{30,25,15\} .
blocks.zh: 我们认为,一个只反应的视图没有字数限制和三个长度控制视图。 在只有回应的无头视图中,法官会看到对话上下文,附图,最后的回复只有;即时排除了思维部分,没有使用特定思维的评价标准. 这种观点显示了相同的偏好趋势,但仍可能受到反应长度差异的影响. 因此,我们把所报告的控制结果集中在长度控制上限30/上限25/上限15的视图上。 在这些观点中,每个候选人的回答在大多数N N 词前排为前缀,其中N {} { 30, 25, 15} N\in } 30, 25, 15}} .

blocks.en: C.2 Controlled Pairwise Results
blocks.zh: C.2 控制对等结果

blocks.en: Table 19 reports blind pairwise preference outcomes under the three length-controlled views (cap-30, cap-25, and cap-15) on the MESC-FT test set and MELD-ESC300.
blocks.zh: 表19在MESC-FT测试集和MELD-ESC300的三种长度控制视图(Cap-30、Cap-25和Cap-15)下报告了盲双偏好结果。

blocks.en: Table 19: Controlled pairwise evaluation results. Each cell reports majority-vote decisions. Model A denotes Ours (Full), and Model B denotes FIRES (Baseline).
blocks.zh: 表19:经控制的对等评价结果。 每个小组都报告多数投票决定。 型号A表示我们的(Full),型号B表示FIRES(Baseline).

blocks.en: Across both datasets, Model A remains consistently preferred under all length-controlled views. As the word cap becomes stricter, the win rate of Model A gradually decreases, but Model A still clearly outperforms Model B even under the most restrictive cap-15 setting. Since cap-15 removes explicit reasoning content and imposes the strongest constraint on visible response length, it provides the most conservative evidence in this appendix.
blocks.zh: 两个数据集,模型 在所有长期控制的观点下,始终倾向于保留。 随着单词封顶变得更加严格,Model A的胜率逐渐下降,但Model A即使在最严格的封顶-15设定下,仍然明显优于Model B. 由于上限-15删除了明确的推理内容,并对可见的反应长度施加了最强的制约,因此它在本附录中提供了最保守的证据.

blocks.en: C.3 Statistical Significance
blocks.zh: C.3 统计意义

blocks.en: To assess whether the observed preference advantages in the controlled pairwise evaluation are statistically reliable, we further perform significance testing on the main comparisons. For each dataset and each reported length-controlled view, we apply a two-sided exact binomial sign test over decisive (i.e., non-tie) comparisons only, and estimate 95% confidence intervals for the FACES preference share via bootstrap resampling. This analysis does not introduce any new evaluation criterion; rather, it provides a statistical summary, including confidence intervals, of the majority-vote pairwise results reported in the main text and appendix.
blocks.zh: 为了评估受控对等评价中观察到的偏好优势在统计学上是否可靠,我们进一步对主要比较进行意义测试。 对于每个数据集和每个报告的长度控制视图,我们只对决定性(即非tie)的比较进行双侧精确的二元标志测试,并通过靴子套装估计FACES偏好份额95%的置信间隔。 这一分析没有引入任何新的评价标准,而是对正文和附录中报告的多数投票对等结果提供了统计摘要,包括信任间隔。

blocks.en: The results show that FACES remains significantly preferred over the baseline under all reported length-controlled views on both the MESC-FT test set and MELD-ESC300. Notably, even under the most conservative cap-15 condition, where explicit reasoning traces are hidden and the judge can access only length-truncated final responses, FACES still attains a decisive preference share of 87.2% on the MESC-FT test set (95% CI: 83.9%–90.4%, p ≈ 2.0 × 10 − 57 p\approx 2.0\times 10^{-57} ) and 86.5% on MELD-ESC300 (95% CI: 81.9%–91.2%, p ≈ 3.1 × 10 − 29 p\approx 3.1\times 10^{-29} ). These results suggest that the observed preference gains are not merely driven by visible CoT content or longer responses, but remain robust under substantially restricted judging conditions.
blocks.zh: 结果显示,在MESC-FT测试机组和MELD-ESC300的所有报告的长度控制观点下,FACES仍然比基线更偏好。 值得注意的是,即使在最保守的上限-15条件下,即隐藏了明确的推理痕迹,而且法官只能获取长调的最后答复,FACES仍然在MESC-FT测试集上获得87.2%的决定性偏好份额(95% CI:83.9 %–90.4%,p 2.0 × 10 − 57 p\\\时数 10^{57}),在MELD-ESC 300上获得86.5%的偏好份额(95% CI:81.9 %–91.2%,p 3.1. × 10 − 29 p\\时数 10^{29})。 这些结果表明,所观察到的优惠增益不仅受到明显的《公约》内容或更长的答复的驱动,而且在严格限制的条件下仍然强劲。

blocks.en: C.4 Cross-Judge Robustness
blocks.zh: C.4 跨法官实力

blocks.en: To examine whether the preference results are specific to a Qwen-family evaluator, we add GLM-4.6V-Flash as an independent judge. We retain the same three prompt variants, bidirectional candidate swapping, length control, and majority voting. Each result reports FACES win/FIRES win/tie.
blocks.zh: 为了审查偏好结果是否专门针对一个Wen家庭评价员,我们增加了GLM-4.6V-Flash作为独立法官. 我们保留了相同的三个即时变体,双向候选人互换,长度控制和多数投票. 每个结果都报告FACES胜/FIRES胜/tie.

blocks.en: Table 20: Cross-judge pairwise preferences (%). Both judges evaluate the same candidate pairs. Cap- N N views truncate final responses to at most N N words; response-only uses no word cap.
blocks.zh: 表20:双向双向法官偏好(%)。 两位法官都评价同一对候选人。 船长... N N 视图将最终回复切换到最多为N N 的单词;仅回复不使用单词上限.

blocks.en: Table 21: Cap-15 blind pairwise comparisons between FACES and directly prompted strong MLLMs. Each cell reports FACES win/opponent win/tie percentages.
blocks.zh: 表21: Cap-15在FACES中盲目对偶比较和直接引发强MLLMs. 每个单元格报告FACES赢/赞成赢/领奖百分比。

blocks.en: Table 20 reports the results obtained with the independent GLM judge. On MESC-FT, GLM assigns FACES win rates of 84.9%, 97.1%, and 99.6% under cap-15, cap-25, and unrestricted response-only evaluation, respectively. Under cap-15, the corresponding win rates are 64.3% on StickerConv and 65.7% on AvaMERG. After ties are excluded, the cap-15 preference shares on MESC-FT, StickerConv, and AvaMERG are 93.4%, 76.8%, and 80.4%, respectively, all significantly above chance under the reported sign tests ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). These results show a consistent length-controlled preference across the two judge families.
blocks.zh: 表20向独立的GLM法官报告了结果。 在MESC-FT上,GLM指定FACES的胜率分别为84.9%,97.1%,99.6%在上限15下,上限-25下,以及无限制的只回应评价. 在上限15下,对应的胜率在StacerConv为64.3%,在AvaMERG为65.7%。 在排除联系后,MESC-FT、粘贴商Conv和AvaMERG的上限至15优先份额分别是93.4%、76.8%和80.4%,在所报告的标志测试中都大大高于机会( < 0.001 p < 0.001)。 这些结果显示,在两个法官家庭之间,长期控制的偏好始终如一。

blocks.en: C.5 Strong Direct-Prompted MLLMs
blocks.zh: C.5 强有力的直接催化的MLLMs

blocks.en: We compare FACES with six directly prompted strong MLLMs on MESC-FT (450 test instances) and MELD-ESC300 (300 external test instances). MESC-FT assesses in-domain performance, while MELD-ESC300 assesses cross-dataset transfer without additional fine-tuning on the external dataset. None of the six comparison models is task-fine-tuned, and each receives the same dialogue context, visual evidence, and response instruction.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了FACES与MESC-FT(450个试验例)和MELD-ESC300(300个外部试验例)上的6个直接引发的强MLLMs。 MESC-FT评估域内性能,而MELD-ESC300则评估跨数据集传输,而不对外部数据集进行额外的微调. 六个比较模型中没有一个是任务精细调整的,每个模型都得到相同的对话上下文,视觉证据,以及响应指示.

blocks.en: For both datasets, we apply the cap-15 response-only blind pairwise protocol, removing reasoning traces and prefix-truncating each candidate response to at most 15 words. We use three semantically equivalent judge prompts, bidirectional candidate swapping to reduce presentation order bias, and majority voting. The same fixed candidate responses are evaluated by Qwen2.5-VL-32B-Instruct-AWQ and GLM-4.6V-Flash.
blocks.zh: 对于两个数据集,我们应用上限-15响应单盲对偶协议,去除推理痕迹,并在前缀中将每个候选响应最多15个单词. 我们使用三个同名法官的提示, 双向候选人互换, Quen2.5-VL-32B-Instruct-AWQ和GLM-4.6V-Flash对同样的固定候选反应进行了评价.

blocks.en: Table 21 shows that FACES is preferred over all six opponents by both judges on both datasets. On MESC-FT, its win rates range from 71.6% to 76.7% under Qwen and from 69.3% to 74.0% under GLM. On MELD-ESC300, the corresponding ranges are 65.0%–70.0% and 62.0%–67.0%. The lower win rates on MELD-ESC300 indicate a smaller preference advantage under cross-dataset evaluation, but the direction of preference remains consistent for every opponent. GLM also assigns lower FACES win rates than Qwen throughout, while preserving the same overall conclusion. This consistency provides evidence that the observed advantage is not confined to evaluation by a Qwen-family judge.
blocks.zh: 表21显示,两个法官在两个数据集中都倾向于FACES,而不是所有六个反对者。 在MESC-FT中,其赢利率在Quen的71.6%至76.7%之间,在GLM的69.3%至74.0%之间。 在MELD-ESC300上,相应的范围为65.0%~70.0%,62.0%~67.0%. MELD-ESC300上的较低赢率表明,在跨数据集评价下,偏好优势较小,但偏好的方向对每个对手来说仍然一致. GLM在整个过程中还给出了低于Quen的FACES胜率,同时保留了相同的总体结论. 这种一致性提供了证据表明,所观察到的优势并不限于由一名文家法官进行评估。

blocks.en: Human evaluation provides complementary evidence for the comparison with GPT-4o. Among the six directly prompted MLLMs, only GPT-4o is included in this human comparison. Table 22 reports the complete win, loss, and tie counts under the cap-15 blind protocol. Human annotators prefer FACES in 342 of 450 MESC-FT instances (76.0%) and 216 of 300 MELD-ESC300 instances (72.0%). These preferences agree in direction with both MLLM judges on both datasets. The human results support the comparison with GPT-4o specifically; comparisons with the other five MLLMs rely on the two automatic judges.
blocks.zh: 人类评价为与GPT-4o进行比较提供了补充证据. 在6个直接引发的MLLMs中,只有GPT-4o被包含在这个人类比较中. 表22报告在15号盲标协议下完全胜负,损失和平局计数. 在450个MESC-FT案例中有342个(76.0%)和300个MELD-ESC300案例中有216个(72.0%),人类注释员更喜欢FACES。 这些偏好在两个数据集上都与MLLM的两位法官达成一致。 人的结果具体支持了与GPT-4o的比较;与其他五个MLLM的比较依赖于两个自动裁判.

blocks.en: The three primary annotators comprised two PhD students with experience in affective computing or emotional-support modeling and one lecturer in a related field. blocks.en: Table 27 reports ablations of individual reward dimensions and format control on MESC-FT. We ablate the dimensions used for intermediate reasoning and structural control, but do not ablate the outcome reward because it provides the shared final-response supervision needed for comparable training. Table 28 summarizes the function, responsible semantic span, and scoring signal of each reward dimension. The normalized trends are shown in Figure 3 . blocks.en: Ours (Full) achieves the best METEOR, BERTScore-F1, Distinct-3, and DIFF-EPITOME, indicating the most balanced overall profile. Removing the format constraint increases BLEU-2 and ROUGE-L, but substantially hurts semantic quality and diversity, suggesting that lexical overlap alone does not reflect better support quality. blocks.en: We use MESC-FT as the sole training set because its multimodal emotional support setting and supervision structure align with the structured reasoning and multidimensional reward design of FACES. Adding other datasets during training would change both the amount and distribution of training data, making it difficult to distinguish the effect of the method from the effect of additional data. Accordingly, we reserve MELD-ESC300, StickerConv, and AvaMERG for cross-dataset evaluation without additional training. This choice follows ESC evaluations on datasets not strictly dedicated to ESC: FIRES evaluates on an ESC-oriented EMOTyDA subset Wang et al. (2025a) , while straQ* evaluates on EmpatheticDialogues Wang et al. (2025b) .
blocks.zh: 我们把MESC-FT作为唯一的培训单元,因为它的多模式情感支持设置和监督结构与FACES的结构推理和多层面奖励设计相一致。 在培训期间增加其他数据集将改变培训数据的数量和分布,从而难以区分该方法的效果和补充数据的效果。 因此,我们保留MELD-ESC300、StickerConv和AvaMERG进行跨数据集评价,而不增加培训。 这一选择遵循ESC对并非严格专门用于ESC的数据集的评价:FIRES评价的是面向ESC的EMOTyDA子集Wang等人(2025a),而straQ*评价的是Empathetic Dialgues Wang等人(2025b).

blocks.en: G.1 Benchmark Construction
blocks.zh: G.1 基准建设

blocks.en: To evaluate out-of-domain generalization, we construct an external benchmark, MELD-ESC300, from the MELD test set using the publicly available EMOTyDA resources Poria et al. (2019) ; Saha et al. (2020) , and use it for cross-dataset evaluation without any additional fine-tuning. Rather than directly reusing the original MELD annotations, we filter dialogue segments that better approximate emotional-support scenarios, allowing us to examine whether the model’s gains transfer to a non-training-domain multimodal dialogue setting.
blocks.zh: 为了评估域外通用性,我们利用公开的EMOTyDA资源Poria等人(2019年);Saha等人(2020年),从MELD测试组中构建了一个外部基准MELD-ESC300,并用于跨数据集评价,而无需再作任何微调。 我们不直接使用最初的MELD说明,而是过滤更接近情感支持情景的对话部分,使我们能够审查该模式的收益是否转移到非培训领域多模式对话环境。

blocks.en: Concretely, we treat the i i -th utterance in a dialogue as a candidate target response and retain only samples satisfying the following conditions: (1) at least two preceding turns are available; (2) the target response length is between 4 and 40 words; (3) the target sentiment is not negative and its emotion label belongs to { neutral , joy , surprise } \{\textit{neutral},\textit{joy},\textit{surprise}\} ; this condition is used only to exclude clearly negative target replies and is not treated as a proxy for empathy; (4) the target speaker differs from the speaker in the immediately preceding utterance; and (5) the video clip corresponding to the immediately preceding utterance is available, so that stable visual context can be provided.
blocks.zh: 具体地说,我们把对话中的i-th语作为候选目标响应,只保留符合以下条件的样本:(1) 至少有前两个转弯;(2) 目标响应长度在4至40个字之间;(3) 目标情绪不是负面的,它的情绪标签属于{中性,喜悦,惊喜}\ textit{中性},\textit{joy},\textit{惊奇};这个条件只用于排除明显负面的目标响应,不作为同情的代名词;(4) 目标演讲者与前面的演讲者不同;(5) 与前面的演讲相对应的视频片段,可以提供稳定的视觉背景.

blocks.en: We then apply a two-stage filtering strategy to identify ESC-style samples. A sample is marked as strict if the immediately preceding utterance already exhibits negative affect, i.e., its sentiment is negative or its emotion label belongs to { anger , sadness , fear , disgust } \{\textit{anger},\textit{sadness},\textit{fear},\textit{disgust}\} . If this condition is not met, we further inspect the three most recent preceding utterances; if any of them contains negative affect, the sample is retained and marked as relaxed. Importantly, regardless of whether a sample is selected by the strict or relaxed rule, the visual input is always taken from the video of the immediately preceding utterance, from which we uniformly extract five frames. This design avoids directly leaking visual information associated with the target response itself. The final model input contains at most six preceding turns, and the reference output is the original target utterance.
blocks.zh: 然后我们采用两阶段过滤策略来识别ESC风格的样本. 如果前面的语句已经显示出负面的影响, 即它的情绪是负面的, 或者它的情绪标签属于 {愤怒, 悲伤, 恐惧, 厌恶 }\ textit{anger},\ textit{adness},\ textit{ fear},\ textit{disgust} 。 如果不符合这一条件,我们将进一步检查前三次发言;如果其中任何一次发言含有负面影响,则保留样本,并标为放松。 重要的是,无论样本是被严格规则还是放松规则所选择,视觉输入总是从紧接前一段话的视频中取出,我们统一从中提取五个帧. 这种设计避免了直接泄露与目标响应本身相关的视觉信息. 最终的模型输入最多包含前6个转弯,参考输出为原始目标表达.

blocks.en: Following this procedure with a fixed random seed of 42, we construct a 300-instance benchmark, MELD-ESC300 . Of these, 208 satisfy the strict criterion and 92 are selected by the relaxed criterion. As shown in Table 37 , the target responses are dominated by neutral cases, with a smaller yet non-trivial number of joy and surprise instances. We report only the emotion distribution, as the corresponding sentiment labels are largely implied by the retained target emotion categories in this subset and therefore add limited additional information. These statistics make the composition of the benchmark explicit and reproducible. We also conduct an expert audit of all 300 samples to assess emotional need, response relevance, supportive function, and overall validity.
blocks.zh: 按照这个程序,固定的随机种子为42个,我们构建一个300英寸的基准,MELD-ESC300。 其中208项符合严格标准,92项通过放宽标准选择. 如表37所示,目标答复以中性案例为主,喜剧和惊喜案例数量较少,但非三角。 我们只报告情绪分布,因为相应的情绪标签基本上被这个子集中保留的目标情绪类别所暗示,因此增加了有限的额外信息. 这些统计数字使基准的构成明确和可复制。 我们还对所有300个样本进行专家审计,以评估情感需求、反应相关性、支持功能和总体有效性。

blocks.en: A sample is considered valid only if the preceding context conveys an emotional need and the target response is relevant and plausibly supportive. The same three annotators described in Appendix D.1 independently audited all samples, with the final label for each criterion determined by majority vote. The non-negative target-emotion filter is intended to exclude clearly negative replies, rather than to serve as a proxy for empathy. As shown in Table 38 , 274 of the 300 samples pass the overall validity criterion, yielding validity rates of 91.3% overall, 92.8% for the strict subset, and 88.0% for the relaxed subset. For example, when Phoebe expresses anger about a bad date, Monica responds, “Don’t worry Phoebe, you’re gonna meet someone.” In another case, Joey criticizes himself for being unable to finish his writing, and Ross responds, “I’ll help you.” These examples illustrate that the filtering procedure captures a negative context followed by a relevant and plausibly supportive response, rather than treating the target emotion label as evidence of empathy. Overall, the benchmark centers on mildly supportive or non-negative target replies while still covering a modest range of more explicitly positive feedback.
blocks.zh: 一个样本只有在前述上下文传达情感需求,目标反应相关且具有合理支持性的情况下才被视为有效. 附录D.1所述三个注释员对所有样本进行了独立审计,每项标准的最后标签由多数票确定。 非负面目标情绪过滤器旨在排除明显负面的答复,而不是作为同情的代名词. 如表38所示,300个样本中有274个通过了总体有效性标准,总体有效性率为91.3%,严格子集为92.8%,放松子集为88.0%。 比如,当菲比对糟糕的约会表示愤怒时,莫妮卡回应说,“别担心菲比,你会遇到某个人。 ” 在另一个案例中,乔伊批评自己无法完成他的写作,罗斯回答说,“我会帮助你。 ” 这些例子说明,过滤程序捕捉到一个负面的环境,然后是相关和合理的支持性反应,而不是将目标情感标签作为同情的证据。 总体而言,该基准以微弱的支持性或非否定性目标答复为中心,同时仍涵盖范围不大的、更明确的积极反馈。

blocks.en: We emphasize that MELD-ESC300 is derived from scripted TV dialogue rather than professionally curated emotional-support data, so it is intended as a controlled external generalization test set rather than a replacement for dedicated ESC benchmarks. By combining recent negative-affect context, neutral-to-positive target replies, and visual evidence from the immediately preceding turn, it provides a practical approximation of cross-domain emotional-support scenarios for evaluating transfer beyond the MESC-FT test set.
blocks.zh: 我们强调,MELD-ESC300源于脚本电视对话,而不是专业地整理情感支持数据,因此它旨在作为受控制的外部概括测试集,而不是取代专门的ESC基准. 通过结合近期的负致病背景,中性对阳性目标响应,以及前一个回合的视觉证据,它为评价超出MESC-FT测试集范围的转移提供了跨领域情感支持情景的实际近似.

blocks.en: Table 39 shows that the pointwise average increases from 3.35 for FIRES to 3.73 for FACES , with higher scores on all three dimensions. In the blind pairwise comparison, FACES is preferred in 62.0% of the 300 instances, compared with 9.7% for FIRES; the preference share differs from chance when ties are excluded ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). These results provide evidence that the advantage observed on MESC-FT transfers to MELD-ESC300 under the tested cap-15 protocol without additional training.
blocks.zh: 表39显示,平均点数从FIRES的3.35增至FACES的3.73,所有三个维度的分数都较高。 在盲目对等比较中,在300个案例中,有62.0%倾向于FACES,而FIRES为9.7%;在排除联系时,优先份额不同于机会(p < 0.001 p < 0.001)。 这些结果提供了证据表明,在未进行额外培训的情况下,MESC-FT根据经测试的15号上限协议向MELD-ESC300转让的优势。

blocks.en: Beyond MELD-ESC300, we evaluate transfer to StickerConv and AvaMERG without additional training. Table 41 reports the blind pairwise results, while Table 42 reports the corresponding automatic evaluation. We sample 300 test instances from each dataset with seed 42. StickerConv uses textual sticker cues in the dialogue context, while AvaMERG uses dialogue text and five uniformly sampled facial frames per instance, with audio excluded. For each dataset, responses are generated greedily and evaluated using the same blind pairwise protocol as the main experiments: three semantically equivalent judge prompts, bidirectional candidate swapping, prefix truncation under cap-15 and cap-25 settings, and majority voting. Statistical significance is assessed with a two-sided exact binomial sign test over non-tied comparisons, and confidence intervals are estimated using 5,000 bootstrap resamples.

blocks.en: The automatic results are complementary rather than uniformly one-sided. FACES mainly improves supportive semantics, diversity, and DIFF-EPITOME, while FIRES remains competitive on some lexical or embedding-based metrics.
blocks.zh: 自动结果是相辅相成的,而不是统一的单方面。 FACES主要改进了支持语义、多样性和DIFF-EPITOME,而FIRES在一些词典或嵌入式衡量标准上仍然具有竞争力。

blocks.en: Appendix H Case Study
blocks.zh: 附录H 案例研究

blocks.en: To complement the controlled pairwise results, we provide qualitative examples that illustrate where FACES improves over the baseline and where it can still fail. Across the success cases, FIRES often paraphrases the user’s surface expression, whereas FACES more consistently follows a chain of specific emotion labeling, causal situation interpretation, and targeted exploration. Under aggressive cap-15 truncation, the higher tie rate may reflect the removal of explanatory and strategy-related content, but the FIRES win rate remains low, suggesting that truncation reduces separability rather than reversing the preference. The failure case illustrates an important boundary: once the visual cue is misread, the error can propagate through situation inference and strategy selection. In panel (F) of Figure 4 , Mona holds a photograph, which FIRES correctly describes as a picture taken of her. FACES , however, mistakes it for a phone and responds as though she were showing something to Ross and Joey. The result is a fluent but visually ungrounded follow-up. Gated reward fusion can suppress poor final behavior during training, but it cannot fully repair incorrect upstream perception. The figure compares the dialogue context, visual cue, baseline response, FACES response, and a brief analysis for six representative cases, covering in-domain success, length-controlled success, cross-dataset transfer, and a failure case.
blocks.zh: 为了补充可控对等结果,我们提供了定性实例,说明外地资产管制系统在哪些方面改进了基线,哪些方面仍然可能失败。 在所有成功的案例中,FIRES经常解释用户的表层表达,而FACES则更一贯地遵循一系列具体的情感标签、因果关系解释和有针对性的探索。 在激进的封顶-15的截断下,较高的平局率可能反映出删除了解释性内容和战略相关内容,但FIRES的胜率仍然很低,说明截断会减少隔离性,而不是扭转偏好. 失败案例说明了一个重要的界限:一旦视觉提示被误读,错误可以通过情境推论和策略选择来传播. 在图4的面板(F)中,Mona持有一张照片,FIRES正确地描述为拍摄了她的照片. 但是,FACES错误地把它当作一个电话 并回答好像她在向罗斯和乔伊展示的东西。 结果是一个流利但视而不见的后续行动。 受嘉奖聚变在训练期间可以抑制不良的最终行为,但它不能完全修复不正确的上游认知. 该图比较了对话的背景、视觉提示、基线反应、FACES反应,以及六个有代表性的案例的简要分析,包括域内的成功、长控成功、跨数据集传输和失败案例。
